title: 第九章 真正的九劫总纲！
slug: 傲世九重天全本免费-傲世九重天最新章节列表
content_zh:
立在石壁上，等到呼吸完全平静下来，他才将金血玄参放进口中，用牙齿轻轻咬破表皮，顿时一股清凉中带着辛辣的液体灌喉而入。这汁液，竟然是黄金的颜色，灿灿发光。
金血玄参的名字便是从此而来。这，就是金血！
金血玄参参液一入体，便自动舒缓的流向全身经脉。便在此时，丹田之中的九劫剑剑魂突然传出一阵兴奋的情绪，猛的躁动起来，随即化作一道闪电，居然冲出丹田，迅速地迎了上来。带着一种欣喜……
还未来得及被经脉吸收的参液，化作一道流光，尽数被九劫剑吸了进去！
楚阳居然感觉到，九劫剑竟然似乎发出了一声满足的饱嗝，这才慢悠悠的回归丹田，很是有一种酒足饭饱之后散散步的感觉，摇头摆尾，居然是派头十足……
虽然是在悬崖之上，但楚阳几乎就笑了出来。这家伙，也太人性化了吧？
随即，剑身上黯淡的金光一闪，这一次，很明显比上一次要亮了许多，随即光芒消失，从九劫剑那虚幻的剑柄处，流出一道冰凉的暗金颜色气流，刹那间融进楚阳全身经脉，楚阳眼睁睁的看着自己裸露在外的肌肤上金光一闪，接着消失，浑身的经脉气蛤蟆一般一阵鼓胀，然后回收，紧接着再次鼓胀了一次……
就像是一个气球，被人吹一口，接着放掉气；然后接着吹一口……
如此，连续九次，终于没有了这种感觉。
经由九劫剑改造过的金血玄参参液的药力，终于彻底的融合在楚阳的经脉之中……
楚阳分明感觉到，自己的功力虽然没有增加，但运行起来，速度却快了许多，而自己经脉之中，也有一层金色的柔韧光芒正在慢慢消失，融进了自己的经脉内壁……
试着鼓荡了一下经脉，感觉着经脉之中传来的那种极度的弹性和柔韧，就如同打不破的皮球一样的感觉，让楚阳大喜过望！
这次的收获，将奠定自己一生的基础！收获太大了……功力虽然不能增加，但却为自己开辟了一个直线向上的经脉通畅大道！
如果说别人的经脉只是一个小水池，那自己的经脉无疑就变成了一眼深井。这是质的区别！
这次的基础，足以让自己一直升级到武宗而不必担心经脉的容量和承受力的问题。
他还未来得及惊喜，便感觉到丹田中的九劫剑突然浑身光彩大亮，煌煌然让楚阳有一种自己全身都要被照射的透明的感觉。紧接着，丹田一痛，光芒瞬间消失无踪，但楚阳知道，有一件玄妙的事情正在发生……
他的心中，突然就冒出来几句话：
“天道无情，万物皆毁；天道有情，万物皆生。剑道无情，屠戮天下；剑道有情，心念苍生。有情无情，在乎一心。九劫九重，无情乎，有情也。有情乎，无情也；
历经沧海，看透世情，有情即是无情，无情即是有情；有情无情，深处便是天道。有人世，便有武道，有武道，晋天道，到头便是超脱。
世俗人间，天道之秘，尽在其中，七情六欲，天道之始……”

楚阳浑身剧震，只感觉心中一阵剧烈激荡，一阵头晕目眩，这一刻，险些从石壁上摔了下去。
在这无人看得到的悬崖峭壁上，楚阳浑身颤抖了起来，几乎不能自持。
前世一路修炼艰难，终于不惜以邪门功法促进，以杀戮入剑道，但却始终不能了然明悟，更不要提什么武道巅峰，现在，楚阳终于知道了自己错在哪里！
原来自己前世一生修炼无情剑道，竟然是错了！大错特错！
这里，才是真正的九劫九重天心法总纲！
什么无情有情，都在自己心里。自己的心无情，便是无情剑道。自己的心有情，便是有情剑道！
修炼到深处，便是天道！
而前世自己心中明明有情，却偏偏要斩情灭情，怎么能成功？！
一篇总纲，却是两条路。一条路成圣，另一条路，却是成魔！如何修炼，在乎一心啊……
轻舞，原来是我的错误！一开始，我就走错了路。才导致了我们一生的悲剧啊。
楚阳仰面向天，心中抽痛，莫可名状……

content_en:
Standing on the stone wall, he waited until his breathing calmed down completely, then put the Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae into his mouth, gently bit the skin with his teeth, and suddenly a cool and spicy liquid poured down his throat. This juice turned out to be the color of gold, shining brightly.
This is where the name Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae comes from. This is golden blood!
As soon as the Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae ginseng liquid enters the body, it will automatically and soothingly flow to the meridians throughout the body. At this moment, the Nine Tribulations Sword Soul in the dantian suddenly burst into excitement and became violently agitated. Then it turned into a bolt of lightning and unexpectedly rushed out of the dantian and quickly came forward. With a kind of joy...
The ginseng liquid that had not yet had time to be absorbed by the meridians turned into a stream of light and was sucked in by the Nine Tribulations Sword!
Chu Yang actually felt that the Nine Tribulations Sword actually seemed to let out a satisfied burp, and then slowly returned to Dantian. It felt like taking a walk after a meal, shaking his head and tail, and he was actually full of style...
Although he was on the cliff, Chu Yang almost laughed. This guy is too humane, right?
Immediately, the dim golden light on the sword flashed. This time, it was obviously much brighter than the last time. Then the light disappeared. From the illusory hilt of the Nine Tribulations Sword, a cold dark gold color flow flowed out. In an instant, it melted into the meridians of Chu Yang's body. Chu Yang watched helplessly as the golden light flashed on his exposed skin, and then disappeared. The meridians all over his body swelled like a toad, then recovered, and then swelled again...
Like a balloon, someone blows it up, then deflates it; then blows it up again...
This happened nine times in a row, and finally I no longer felt this way.
The medicinal power of the golden-blood Scrophulariaceae ginseng liquid modified by the Nine Tribulations Sword was finally completely integrated into Chu Yang's meridians...
Chu Yang clearly felt that although his skill had not increased, it was running much faster, and in his meridians, there was also a layer of golden, flexible light that was slowly disappearing and melting into the inner walls of his meridians...
He tried to stir his meridians and felt the extreme elasticity and flexibility coming from his meridians, like an unbreakable rubber ball. Chu Yang was overjoyed!
This harvest will lay the foundation for my life! The harvest is too great... Although the skill cannot be increased, it has opened up a straight upward avenue for unobstructed meridians!
If someone else's meridians are just a small pool, then your own meridians are undoubtedly a deep well. This is a qualitative difference!
This time's foundation is enough to allow me to upgrade to Wu Zong without having to worry about the capacity and endurance of the meridians.
Before he could be surprised, he felt that the Nine Tribulations Sword in his dantian suddenly shone brightly, so brightly that Chu Yang felt as if his entire body was being illuminated. Immediately afterwards, there was pain in his dantian, and the light disappeared instantly, but Chu Yang knew that something mysterious was happening...
A few words suddenly popped up in his mind:
"The way of heaven is ruthless, all things are destroyed; the way of heaven is sentient, all things are alive. The way of sword is ruthless, slaughtering the world; the way of sword is sentient, thinking about the common people. Being ruthless, it depends on one heart. The nine calamities and the nine levels are ruthless, and there is emotion. There is emotion, and there is ruthlessness;
After going through the sea, I have seen through the world. Sentiment is ruthlessness, ruthlessness is sentimentality; there is love and ruthlessness, and the way of heaven is in the depths. When there is a human being, there is martial arts, there is martial arts, Jintian Dao, and in the end it is transcendence.
In the secular world, the secrets of the way of heaven are all there, the seven emotions and six desires are the beginning of the way of heaven..."
Chu Yang's whole body was shaken, and he felt a violent excitement in his heart, and he felt dizzy. At this moment, he almost fell off the stone wall.
On this cliff that no one could see, Chu Yang trembled all over and could hardly control himself.
In the previous life, he had been practicing hard all the way, and finally he did not hesitate to use evil techniques to promote it, and entered the way of swordsmanship through killing, but he still could not understand it clearly, let alone mention anything.At the pinnacle of martial arts, Chu Yang finally knows where he went wrong!
It turns out that I was wrong in practicing ruthless swordsmanship in my previous life! Big mistake!
Here is the real outline of the Nine Tribulations and Nine Layers of Heavenly Mind Dharma!
Whatever is ruthless or sentimental, it's all in your own heart. If one's heart is ruthless, it is ruthless swordsmanship. If you have feelings in your heart, that is the way of swordsmanship!
Once you practice to the depths, you will become the way of heaven!
In the previous life, I clearly had feelings in my heart, but I wanted to kill them. How could I succeed? !
A general outline, but two paths. One way is to become a saint, the other way is to become a devil! How to practice cultivation depends on single-mindedness...
Qingwu, it turned out to be my mistake! From the beginning, I was on the wrong track. This has led to the tragedy of our lives.
Chu Yang looked up to the sky, feeling an indescribable pain in his heart...
